name: @repo/ai-message
description: Chat message bubble whose action row slides out of the bubble's own edge, revealed on hover and on focus.

useCases: User and assistant turns in a chat thread
Message with copy, retry and feedback actions
Thread rows that need an avatar or orb slot
compositionHints: Actions reveal on hover and focus-within, so keyboard users reach them
Pass copyText to enable the clipboard action
Drop an orb into avatar to tie the message to the assistant presence
